Lamis Alhussein Abdel Aziz (born 24 April 1998) is an Egyptian tennis player. On 14 July 2025, she achieved her career-high singles ranking of 478. Playing for Egypt , she has a win–loss record in Billie Jean King Cup competition of 4–11 (as of July 2024).
